Reasoning: This release stage keeps the panda_fingertip pose fixed while opening the gripper. freeze_position enforces the start-of-stage fingertip position with the specified 0.01 m tolerance, and freeze_orientation enforces the start-of-stage fingertip orientation with a 5 degree tolerance. open_gripper represents commanding both fingers toward the fully open/released state. The API cannot explicitly encode individual left/right finger joint targets, finger effort dropping to free-space levels, loss of bilateral contact with top_drawer_handle_frame, or finger-effort jamming detection; those are omitted except insofar as open_gripper captures the intended open state. Pose-deviation stopping is represented by the freeze constraints failing if tolerance is exceeded.
